finite_scope_rules.allowlist_semantics: COPY_BATCH6_ALLOWLIST lists the 104 copied target files only. It excludes the three root COPY_BATCH6 metadata files. COPY_BATCH6_SHA256SUMS covers all 104 targets plus this allowlist and receipt, and excludes itself.
finite_scope_rules.source_schema_differences: Original local/full/config manifests hash source payloads only; source signal manifests additionally hash their allowlist. Do not compare source manifest counts as though they shared one schema. Exact membership and hashes are recorded above.
finite_scope_rules.full_v1_partial_selection: Seven source-public-allowlisted runtime configuration/bootstrap driver files were excluded. Its original PUBLIC_ALLOWLIST and PUBLIC_SHA256SUMS were copied as SOURCE_PUBLIC_ALLOWLIST and SOURCE_PUBLIC_SHA256SUMS. These document source provenance, not completeness of the copied target directory. Batch6 manifest is authoritative for copied-target membership.
finite_scope_rules.private_inputs: Raw identities, arbitrary payloads, original private runtime configuration, source databases, key material, original application logs and binary profiles remain outside this finite copied set. Their excluded inputs are not claimed fully archived.
finite_scope_rules.batch128_proposal_material_only: The approved config/signal groups include pre-execution proposal/diff/controlled-prediction documents. No full-original-distribution-batch128-v1 execution directory or its ongoing diagnostic outputs are selected.
